create_StochasticDropout: create a stochastic dropout layer that randomly masks out elements with a given drop rate and scales the output
build_DisabledDropout: build a disabled no-op dropout layer that passes inputs through unchanged while preserving drop rate configuration
test_maybe_dropout: test the maybe_dropout function that returns StochasticDropout when drop_rate is a float or DisabledDropout when None
refactor_StochasticDropout_disable: refactor a StochasticDropout layer to a DisabledDropout by calling its disable method
review_DisabledDropout_enable: review the DisabledDropout enable method that reconstructs a StochasticDropout from saved drop rate and share_across_axes
